IQ and corruption is something I've thought about a bit but there were so many variables and inconsistencies I kind of gave up.

I can't even get anywhere near to a definition of corruption that I'm happy with. Throw in other variables such as culture, past corruption in western countries that are now considered less corrupt, the idea of low income working class people (linked to a lower iq than their higher earning contemporaries) being more honest than the higher achievers. High achievers being linked with sociopathy. Ireland (Where my direct lineage is from) has one of the lowest IQs in Europe but in popular culture at least would be considered a lot less corrupt than Italy with its high comparable iq. I've seen one study which showed the difference in iq between Ireland and Italy was approaching the same iq difference between whites and African Americans.

And what about the citizens of countries where one set has far more opportunities for corruption than the citizens of others, due to a difference in funding for proper accountability processes for example?

Also would the police/mafia corruption in the major US cities in the last century be considered a worse or more prevalent form of corruption than an African city of millions being without electricity because the African customs chiefs want kick backs before they will release the parts needed for maintenance of a hydro electric generator?

Maybe if IQ is linked to national income then corruption is just correlated directly with national income and not directly with IQ?

I think there are situations where a single incidence of corruption might be linked to IQ such as the low IQ link with instant gratification and an inability to take long term consequences into account (personal and communal consequences)

I also wonder if having a critical mass of an intelligent population might be conducive to putting anti corruption measures in place and maintained as a national policy and having those measures followed through. Basically Kenya for example just doesn't have enough high IQ people to implement and maintain an anti corruption policy.

My intuition says there may well be a link between IQ and corruption but it becomes such a complex subject that I can't begin to unravel it.
